ov: فيلم أُصدر سنة 1962، من إخراج ياسوجيرو أوزو
plotEn:
In 1962 Tokyo, Shūhei Hirayama is an aging widower with a 32-year-old married son, Kōichi, and two unmarried children, 24-year-old daughter Michiko and 21-year-old son Kazuo. Since his marriage, Kōichi has moved out to live with his wife, Akiko, in a small flat, leaving Shūhei and Kazuo to be looked after by Michiko.
Shūhei and five of his classmates from middle-school, Kawai, Horie, Sugai, Watanabe and Nakanishi, hold regular reunions at a restaurant called Wakamatsu ("Young Pine"), which is owned by Sugai. They reminisce about old times and banter with each other. Horie is teased about having a new young wife and asked whether he is taking pills to maintain his virility.
Their old teacher of Chinese classics, Sakuma, nicknamed Hyōtan ("The Gourd"), attends one of the reunions. He remarks that Shūhei went from school to the Imperial Japanese Naval Academy. Sakuma has too much to drink, and when Kawai and Shūhei take him home, they find that he has fallen on hard times and is running a cheap noodle restaurant in a working-class area. They meet his middle-aged daughter Tamako, who missed the chance to marry when young and is now too old.
Sakuma's former pupils decide to help him out by gifting him money and Shūhei goes back to the restaurant to hand it over. While he is there, Yoshitarō Sakamoto, the owner of a small local car-repair shop, comes in for a bowl of noodles and recognises Shūhei as the captain of the ship in which he served as a petty officer during the war.
